purpose: Controlled real-photograph input for the Real-ESRGAN G2-R1 4x run, prepared while the GPU is owned by another experiment.

source.title: View of Africa and Madagascar from the Apollo 17 spacecraft
source.license: Public domain (NASA media usage guidelines; NASA content is not copyrighted)

derivation.method: Center crop to 4:3, then high-quality bicubic resize to 384x288 with System.Drawing, saved as PNG

run.device: Vulkan device 0: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (Intel UHD 770 enumerated, not selected)
run.gpu_window: granted by the Lead explicitly; nvidia-smi checked before/after; GPU released after ~2.3 s

note: Real photograph run recorded as a supplement to the two G2-R1 runs; the frozen contract (model/scale/tile/single GPU/no TTA) is identical.
